user.title: Recipes
user.description: Add a recipe manager to your Home Assistant sidebar.

import_recipe.name: Import recipe
import_recipe.description: Imports a recipe from a web page and stores it.

add_to_shopping_list.name: Add to shopping list
add_to_shopping_list.description: Adds a recipe's ingredients to a to-do list, skipping items already on it.

servings.name: Servings
servings.description: Scale to this many servings instead of using a multiplier.

units.name: Units
units.description: grams (weights/volumes converted where possible) or original.

ingredients.name: Ingredients
ingredients.description: Only these ingredient positions (0-based); default is all.

makes.name: Makes
makes.description: Scale to this many of the recipe's yield (for example 16 pancakes). Without scale, servings or makes, the recipe's default multiplier is used.

test_timer_sound.name: Test timer sound
test_timer_sound.description: Plays the timer alert on the speakers chosen in the integration's options.

stop_timer_alarm.name: Stop timer alarm
stop_timer_alarm.description: Dismisses all finished timers and silences their repeating alarms.

snooze_timer.name: Snooze timer
snooze_timer.description: Gives finished timers more time and silences their alarms.

timer_id.name: Timer
timer_id.description: A single timer to snooze; leave empty for all finished timers.

plan_meal.name: Plan a meal
plan_meal.description: Puts a recipe on the meal plan.

servings.name: Servings
servings.description: Scale to this many servings instead of using a multiplier.

note.name: Note
note.description: An optional note shown with the meal.

clear_meal_plan.name: Clear the meal plan
clear_meal_plan.description: Removes planned meals for a day or a range of days.

end.name: To
end.description: Defaults to the same day as From.

slot.name: Meal
slot.description: Only this meal; leave empty for all.

add_plan_to_shopping_list.name: Add the plan to the shopping list
add_plan_to_shopping_list.description: Adds the ingredients of the planned recipes to a to-do list, skipping items already on it.

init.title: Timer alerts
init.description: Choose how you want to be told when a kitchen timer finishes. Timers also fire the `hass_recipes_timer_finished` event for automations. Speakers need a reachable internal URL (Settings > System > Network) to play the chime.

data_description.notify_service: Optional. A notify service, for example your phone, called when a timer finishes.
data_description.speakers: Optional. Media players that play the alert.
data_description.speaker_sound: A short chime, the timer's name spoken aloud, or both.
data_description.tts_entity: Used for spoken messages. Leave empty to use the first available engine.
data_description.alarm_repeat: Keep sounding the alert until you dismiss the timer in the panel (or call the stop_timer_alarm service).
data_description.alarm_minutes: A safety limit so the alert cannot ring for ever when nobody is home.
data_description.edit_access: Everyone can read and cook either way. Choose administrators only to stop other users from creating, editing, importing or deleting recipes and from changing the meal plan.

cards_resource_not_registered.title: The Recipes dashboard cards could not be added
cards_resource_not_registered.description: The Recipes cards are normally added to your dashboard resources automatically, but this is not possible here (dashboard resources mode: {mode}). Add this resource yourself, as a JavaScript module, under Settings > Dashboards > ⋮ > Resources, or in the `resources:` list of your YAML dashboards: `{url}`. The cards are not available until then.
